entry.name: HUD Fair Market Rents FY2026 by County: completeness & spread
entry.description: County-level FY2026 Fair Market Rents: 3,229 county-equivalents across 56 states and territories, five bedroom sizes with median and max per row, 67 multi-FMR-area counties flagged with an area_rows count, and a derived table of the 8 counties where the 2BR max exceeds the median (Bristol County MA +47.5%). Zero empty cells.
